lines.trans: Sorry, mom, I was very late today.
Why did you come home so late?
I walked for a long time with my friends.
You got lucky that dad is sleeping.
Is dad really angry with me?
Dad lost all our money again.
Did he play with our money again?
Yes, he placed bets on football.
And his favorite team lost again?
Yes, his favorite Spartak lost again.
Now do we have no money at all?
It is alright, son, we will cope with everything.
Tomorrow I will find myself a good job.

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outside

examples.trans: A girl walks a little dog there.
Let's go for a walk in the park.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.
He talks for a long time.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.
I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

examples.text: А ты готовишь мой любимый торт со сгущёнкой!
examples.trans: And you make my favourite condensed milk cake!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: as a reply on its own

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: + на: опоздать на работу = be late for work
declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

повезти.gloss: to be lucky (impersonal); to take (by vehicle)

meanings.note: impersonal, + dative: мне повезло = I was lucky; повезло! = what luck!
пока не поздно = before it's too late

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Why are we going so slowly?
Security will be here any moment.

meanings.note: money, a game, a bet, or an election

examples.trans: I lost it on the stock exchange.

examples.text: Разве ты не знал об этом?

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: to be angry, to be cross

examples.trans: The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

справиться.gloss: to manage, to cope, to handle

meanings.note: often + с + instrumental, or used absolutely

examples.text: Мы за два года тут не справимся.
examples.trans: We won't manage here in two years.

meanings.note: affectionate form of сын, often used as a form of address
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: играть в футбол = to play football

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
